newsitem.title: USA: Health Risk, HealthPlan merger taking longer.
newsitem.headline: Health Risk, HealthPlan merger taking longer.

text.p: Health Risk Management Inc and HealthPlan Services Corp on Thursday said the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission was taking longer than expected to clear filings related to their proposed merger.
HealthPlan agreed to pay about $80 million in cash and stock to acquire Health Risk Management in September. HealthPlan originally expected to deal to close in early 1997.
Health Risk said HealthPlan was working with regulators to clear comments related to its filings, adding no shareholder meeting dates would be set until the filings were cleared.
Either party may terminate the agreement if the deal is not been completed by February 28, Health Risk said.
Health Risk is a managed-care service company. Its shares closed up 1/8 at 16-1/8 on Thursday.
